assertion.statement: At each positive odd contact prime outside S_mul, successful six-group tests and pole soundness imply p^25 divides n1*n2-n3.
assertion.objects: The twelve D_gj tests in each of six groups, R0,R,Theta, the actual indices h,z_i,n_i of points in ZP0, and c*=4M0.
assertion.hypotheses: Input and auxiliary points are typed by the separate membership/scalar graphs; P0 is nontorsion. All displayed denominators and R/Theta² are nonzero. p is outside S_mul, contact roots are distinct, t-1 and c* are p-units. Pole soundness excludes a negative odd valuation of the rational pole input. The logarithm/truncation result is available.
assertion.quantifiers: Every successful assignment, every such positive odd contact prime, with one common group and one place over p selected by the contradiction.
assertion.parameter_range: p>324, unramified v(p)=1; thresholds1 for the first eight tests and25 for the last four.
assertion.uniformity: One fixed six-group construction and fixed c* for all rational assignments; the selected group/place may depend on p.
assertion.constants: alpha=v_p(R)<=delta=v_p(R0), both odd; failed tests give v(W_g^-1)>=2delta-alpha. Error threshold28 exceeds25.
assertion.normalizations: Conjugate the primed ratio before subtracting it. Traces are from K0 to Q. Full-log ratios are rational index quotients, using the same P0 and its conjugate.
assertion.exceptional_cases: Some factors need not be units. Establish integrality from whichever of h,h-c* is a unit, transfer it using the difference test, and only then use absolute error congruences. Negative and zero n_i are allowed; nonzero ratio denominators rule out identity denominator points.
assertion.limit_order: Assume all groups fail at all places, obtain a negative odd pole valuation and contradict soundness; choose a common passing group/place, prove integrality, transfer full-log congruences, then apply the product test.
